title: Temasek CIO Says AI, Inflation Pose Biggest Market Risks in 2027
key_facts: Rohit Sipahimalani is Temasek International's chief investment officer.
He spoke at the Milken Institute Asia Summit on 6 Oct 2026.
He named AI investments and inflation-driven bond yield rises as key risks.
He said turbulence from AI could arise as early as 2027.
The comments come as US earnings season approaches and debate grows over AI spending returns.
quote_evidence: On October 06, 2026, Temasek International's Chief Investment Officer, Rohit Sipahimalani, highlighted key risks facing global markets, particularly concerning AI investments and inflation-driven bond yield increases.
why_it_matters_hint: A big sovereign investor sees AI spending and inflation as the main market risks next year.
